summary:
**WEEK 6: THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK (AND COSMOHOUCK STRIKES HARDEST)**

Ladies and gentlemen, we just witnessed the fantasy football equivalent of the Red Wedding from Game of Thrones—brutal, unexpected, and leaving half the league wondering what just happened. Cosmohouck, sitting pretty at #1 in the power rankings with a 97.2 rating, just delivered a 155.96-point ANNIHILATION of TophTT that would make Thanos proud. Kenneth Walker went full Infinity Gauntlet with 26.9 points, Drake Maye added 23.8, and suddenly TophTT's 101.8—a perfectly respectable score that would've won FOUR other matchups this week—looked like bringing a lightsaber to a Death Star fight. That 54.16-point beatdown? That's not just a win, that's a statement. That's cosmohouck saying "I am inevitable."

Meanwhile, PrinceofPizza pulled off the week's most dramatic finish, edging drobs by just 5.20 points in a nail-biter that came down to the wire like the final scene in *Rocky*. Bryce Young delivered 19.8 points and Ashton Jeanty chipped in 13.8, just enough to overcome drobs's Isaiah Likely explosion (20.9 points). This is the kind of finish where you're refreshing your phone every thirty seconds during Monday Night Football, stress-eating an entire bag of chips, and texting your league mates in ALL CAPS. PrinceofPizza is trending up like Bitcoin in 2021, averaging 133.4 recently while climbing to that #4 power ranking.

Can we talk about the complete collapse of briankibler's lineup? Starting Brenen Thompson and Efton Chism—who combined for a magnificent ZERO POINTS—is like casting Ben Affleck as Daredevil: seemed like a good idea at the time, but in hindsight, what were you thinking? Even with Jayden Daniels (21.0) and Aaron Rodgers (16.0) doing their best superhero team-up impression, you can't overcome double-zero performances. That's not a dud, that's a catastrophic system failure. mjgrana cruised to victory behind Christian McCaffrey's 26.2 points, because CMC is basically the Tom Cruise of fantasy football—consistently delivering blockbuster performances year after year.

**THE BOLD PREDICTION:** Cosmohouck's three-week hot streak and league-leading 160.2 recent average? That's about to cool down HARD next week. You can't sustain 155-point performances—it's like trying to make *The Godfather Part IV*. Lightning doesn't strike the same place forever, and I'm calling for a sub-120 performance that brings them back to Earth. Meanwhile, watch out for Tishathefish bouncing back with fury—when you've got Michael Penix slinging it for 23.1 and JSN hauling in 19.4, that 85.5 stinker is just a bad episode in an otherwise solid season.

**RUN THE TAPE!** Week 6 proved that in fantasy football, just like in *Moneyball*, it's not about the players you have—it's about the players you START. Cosmohouck is playing championship chess while everyone else is playing checkers, and that 54-point demolition will echo through league group chats for weeks!
